title: ON Semiconductor Reports Third Quarter 2012 Results
主要内容: ON Semiconductor reported its third quarter 2012 results, with total revenues of $725.5 million, a decline of approximately three percent compared to the second quarter of 2012. The company reported GAAP net income of $12.5 million, or $0.03 per fully diluted share, and non-GAAP net income of $53.5 million, or $0.12 per fully diluted share. The GAAP net income was impacted by $41.0 million of special items. Non-GAAP gross margin was 33.2 percent, and adjusted EBITDA for the quarter was $115.7 million. The company also extended the maturity of its convertible senior subordinated notes from December 2013 to December 2016 and repurchased 4.1 million shares of common stock. ON Semiconductor's CEO, Keith Jackson, noted that the company took actions to reduce non-GAAP operating expenses by approximately 7 percent compared to the second quarter of 2012. ON Semiconductor reported its third quarter 2012 results, highlighting its continued share repurchase activities and the challenges in the short lead-time environment. The company noted a stabilization in its 4-week and 13-week booking trends, indicating a potential bottoming of revenues in the next one to two quarters. For the fourth quarter of 2012, the company projected revenues of $650 to $690 million, with backlog levels representing 80 to 85 percent of anticipated revenues. Average selling prices were expected to decline by approximately two percent compared to the third quarter. The non-GAAP outlook included stock-based compensation expense of $6 million. The company also outlined its GAAP and non-GAAP financial outlook, including gross margin, operating expenses, and tax projections. ON Semiconductor emphasized its strong position to deliver strong free cash flow from operations in 2013. Securities explicitly mentioned in the source include ON Semiconductor Corporation (ONNN), ON Semiconductor (ONNN).
